Biography: Martin Charles Scorsese is an American film director, producer, screenwriter, and actor. He is widely regarded as one of the most significant and influential filmmakers in cinematic history.
Jean-Marc Vallée was a Canadian film director and film editor. He received critical acclaim for his work on films like Dallas Buyers Club and Wild.
Denis Villeneuve is a Canadian film director and writer. He is known for directing critically acclaimed films such as Arrival, Blade Runner 2049, and Dune.
Francis Ford Coppola is an American film director, producer, and screenwriter. He is best known for directing The Godfather trilogy.
Christopher Edward Nolan is a British-American film director, producer, and screenwriter. He is known for his complex storytelling and practical effects.
Frank Árpád Darabont is a Hungarian-American film director, producer, and screenwriter. He is known for directing The Shawshank Redemption and The Green Mile.
